column1: # Real raw files, one or more per format, for the decode tests.
# Not committed. 425 MB of sensor data does not belong in a git repository, and
# these are other people's photographs — we fetch them, we do not redistribute
# them. `scripts/fetch-raw-fixtures.sh` pulls them into a gitignored folder and
# verifies each against the digest below, exactly as the app verifies the AI
# models it downloads.
# Source: https://raw.pixls.us — the sample database free imaging projects
# test against. Uploads are made under CC0 by
# declaration ("I hereby release it under the CC0 license into the public
# domain"); a minority of legacy files imported from rawsamples.ch are not, and
# the site can filter to show them. None of the cameras below appeared on that
# list when this was written. **Confirm the licence on the camera's own page
# before ever redistributing one of these** — testing against a fetched file
# raises no such question, which is why they stay out of the repo.
# Chosen for coverage, not prettiness:
#   CR3  Canon's ISO-BMFF container, nothing like the TIFF-based formats
#   NEF  the most common Bayer raw in the wild
#   RAF  X-Trans — the only entry needing a non-Bayer demosaic path
#   ORF  Four Thirds, and a 12-bit sensor (white level 4095, not 16383)
#   RW2  Panasonic, whose black levels differ per channel
#   ARW  Sony, the format the app was built around — and the a6400 specifically,
#        which is the body the whole ingest path was written against
#   DNG  the format with the most ways to be written, so several:
#          Leica M10     a camera's own, whose sensor clips above its stated white
#          Ricoh GR III  a camera's own, with a negative BaselineExposure
#          DJI Mini 2    a drone: vignetting and a GainMap after demosaic
#          Pixel 7 Pro   a phone: a GainMap per colour, a positive baseline
#          Galaxy S23U   a phone's linear DNG, demosaiced before it was written
#          iPhone 12 Pro ProRAW: linear, 8-bit through a linearisation table
#          Pentax K-3 III Monochrome, as DNG and as PEF: no colour filter
#        (all eight confirmed CC0 on raw.pixls.us, 2026-09-29)
# Add a format by adding a line. Fields: filename, size, sha256, url.
# WARNING, before you set SOURCELIGHT_TEST_RAW locally: it un-skips the
# render tests, and each of those builds a fresh Gpu and recompiles the
# 1,000-line develop shader before it decodes anything. Measured at roughly
# 2.5 minutes per test, so the suite goes from about 25 seconds to the better
# part of an hour. It is not hung. CI does not pay this - the render tests
# skip there for want of a hardware adapter - so this is a deliberate local
# opt-in, not a default.
